title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gym in Auckland with our guide to prices, contracts and locations across the city
intro: Auckland has a wide range of gym options, with prices varying from $15 to over $50 per week. With so many choices, it can be hard to decide which gym is best for you. To help, we've put together a comprehensive guide to the best gyms in Auckland, including their prices, contract terms and locations.

sections.heading: Top Gym Options in Auckland CBD
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, making it easy to find one that suits your needs. Some popular options include CityFitness, which costs $24.95 per week, and Les Mills, which costs $34.95 per week.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms in Auckland
sections.body: If you're looking for a gym that's convenient to get to before or after work, consider a commuter gym. These gyms are typically located near public transport hubs and offer flexible membership options. For example, the Snap Fitness gym in the CBD offers a $29.95 per week membership with no contract.

sections.heading: Gym Options with Parking in Auckland
list: Jetts NZ - multiple locations with free parking
CityFitness - some locations offer free parking, but this varies
Les Mills - paid parking options available at some locations
